summary: Operation Flashpoint entries track the split between Bohemia's original Cold War Crisis/ARMA lineage and Codemasters' later Operation Flashpoint-branded tactical shooters.

entries.title: Operation Flashpoint: Cold War Crisis
entries.definitive_edition: ARMA: Cold War Assault / original PC release with expansion state documented

emulation.notes: Use native PC release; Xbox emulation/hardware only for Elite comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC release with current compatibility fixes and documented expansion/mod state

primary.version: ARMA: Cold War Assault / Operation Flashpoint: Cold War Crisis with Resistance content documented
primary.why: The PC route is the original high-fidelity simulation baseline and the current official digital route under Bohemia's ARMA: Cold War Assault naming. It preserves mouse/keyboard control, mission-editor/mod context, and the expansion lineage better than the later Xbox Elite port.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release where available, then record branding, patch/version, expansion/campaign state, resolution/FOV/widescreen fixes, mods, difficulty, mission, AI settings, and multiplayer/master-server replacement state if tested.

secondary.exclusive_content: Console adaptation with different interface/controller and Xbox Live-era multiplayer context
secondary.what_to_play: Use only for a labeled console-port comparison.
secondary.why: It is a distinct official console version but not the original fidelity/editor/mod route.

secondary.exclusive_content: Additional campaigns and content from the original PC expansion lineage
secondary.what_to_play: Install/document them when building a complete PC capture.
secondary.why: Cold War Crisis, Red Hammer, and Resistance are not interchangeable for story/completeness.

entries.remaster_caveats: Name changed after the Bohemia/Codemasters rights split; record branding, patch, expansion and mod/fix state.
